packet.headline_seed: US strikes hit Iran for seventh consecutive night
packet.description_seed: The US command says it is conducting more strikes to degrade Iran's armed forces, as Iran reports explosions near the Strait of Hormuz.

what: US strikes hit Iran for seventh consecutive night

clean_source_blocks.text: The US command says it is conducting more strikes to degrade Iran's armed forces, as Iran reports explosions near the Strait of Hormuz.

Central Command says attacks were designed to ‘continue degrading Iranian military capabilities’ The US military said it had launched a seventh consecutive night of strikes on Iran on Friday night as fighting escalated over the strait of Hormuz. US Central Command, in a post on X, said the strikes, which began at 7pm GMT, were designed to “continue degrading Iranian military capabilities”. Iranian media reported explosions heard or strikes carried out in the cities of Sirik, Ahvaz and Yazd. And late on Friday night Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said two oil tankers had hit mines in Hormuz and exploded. There were no further details.

Images shared on Friday showed a damaged bridge in Iran's southern Hormozgan province The US military says it is carrying out the seventh night of strikes on Iran since US President Donald Trump declared the temporary ceasefire agreement was "over". "The strikes are designed to continue degrading Iranian military capabilities at the Commander in Chief's direction," the US military Central Command (Centcom) said in a statement. Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said two oil tankers had exploded in the Strait of Hormuz while passing through a mined part of the shipping channel - a claim later dismissed as false by Centcom. Iranian media reported that explosions were heard in the central city of Yazd and at Qeshm island and the port of Bandar Abbas next to the strait.

The United States attacked bridges and other key infrastructure in southern Iran overnight into Friday, capping nearly a week of strikes aimed at intensifying pressure on Tehran to give up control of the Strait of Hormuz. A new round of attacks was announced Friday afternoon by U.S. Central Command. “CENTCOM launched a round of strikes against Iran at 3 p.m. ET today for the seventh consecutive night. The strikes are designed to continue degrading Iranian military capabilities at the Commander in Chief’s direction,” CENTCOM said in a post on X.

The US military says it is carrying out the seventh night of strikes on Iran since US President Donald Trump declared the temporary ceasefire agreement was "over".

"The strikes are designed to continue degrading Iranian military capabilities at the Commander in Chief's direction," the US military Central Command (Centcom) said in a statement.

Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said two oil tankers had exploded in the Strait of Hormuz while passing through a mined part of the shipping channel - a claim later dismissed as false by Centcom.

Iranian media reported that explosions were heard in the central city of Yazd and at Qeshm island and the port of Bandar Abbas next to the strait.

Iran's state-run Fars agency said two oil tankers "exploded and caught fire while passing through a mined route south of the Strait of Hormuz".

Later Centcom posted on X: "Like most IRGC claims, this is false."

Shipping traffic in the vital Strait of Hormuz has largely stopped amid the continuing tit-for-tat strikes by US and Iranian forces. In normal times the strait accounts for about one-fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas supplies.

On Friday, Iran's armed forces claimed to have attacked multiple US military facilities across the Gulf region in Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan and – for the first time – Syria, which the US denied.

Earlier, Kuwaiti officials said Iranian drone strikes had injured a number of their soldiers, while a power plant and water desalination stations had also been damaged.

Sources have told the BBC's US partner CBS news that several American service members were injured during Iranian attacks on two Jordanian bases over the past week.

BBC Verify and BBC Persian have verified footage of damage to Gariveh Bridge, after night videos showed a ball of flames on top of it.

Daylight images showed a crumbled stretch of road with rubble around the broken bridge.

A White House spokesperson told the BBC the US had "carried out strikes exclusively on military targets, including military logistics infrastructure".

The ministry said areas in the south were experiencing “extreme heat and attacks on power infrastructure” as temperatures soared.

payload.title: Yhdysvallat jatkoi iskujaan Iraniin seitsemäntenä yönä
payload.summary: Yhdysvaltain keskusjohto ilmoitti uudesta iskukierroksesta Iraniin. Iranilaismediat raportoivat räjähdyksistä eri puolilla maata, ja Hormuzinsalmen tapahtumista esitettiin ristiriitaisia väitteitä.
payload.content:
Yhdysvaltain asevoimien keskusjohto Centcom ilmoitti käynnistäneensä perjantai-iltana uuden iskukierroksen Iraniin seitsemäntenä peräkkäisenä yönä. Keskusjohdon mukaan iskuilla pyritään heikentämään edelleen Iranin sotilaallista toimintakykyä. Iranilaismediat kertoivat samaan aikaan räjähdyksistä useilla paikkakunnilla, myös Hormuzinsalmen läheisyydessä.

## Uusi iskukierros alkoi illalla

Centcom kertoi uuden iskukierroksen alkaneen perjantaina kello 19 Greenwichin aikaa. Lausunnon mukaan iskut toteutettiin Yhdysvaltain ylipäällikön määräyksestä. Presidentti Donald Trump oli aiemmin julistanut väliaikaisen tulitaukosopimuksen päättyneeksi, minkä jälkeen Yhdysvallat on jatkanut iskujaan Iraniin seitsemänä yönä peräkkäin.

Yhdysvallat iski tietojen mukaan torstain ja perjantain välisenä yönä siltoihin ja muuhun keskeiseen infrastruktuuriin Etelä-Iranissa. Perjantaina jaetuissa kuvissa näkyi vaurioitunut silta Hormozganin maakunnassa. Iskuilla on kerrottu painostettavan Teherania luopumaan Hormuzinsalmen hallinnasta, kun taas Centcom kuvasi tavoitteeksi Iranin sotilaallisen toimintakyvyn heikentämisen.

Etelä-Iranin infrastruktuuriin kohdistuneet hyökkäykset tapahtuivat ennen perjantai-iltana alkanutta uutta kierrosta. Kyse oli lähes viikon jatkuneen operaation seuraavasta vaiheesta. Samaan aikaan taistelujen kerrottiin kiihtyneen Hormuzinsalmen ympärillä.

## Räjähdyksiä raportoitiin eri puolilla Irania

Iranilaismediat kertoivat räjähdyksistä tai iskuista Sirikissä, Ahvazissa ja Yazdissa. Lisäksi räjähdyksiä kerrottiin kuullun Qeshmin saarella ja Bandar Abbasin satamakaupungissa Hormuzinsalmen tuntumassa. Yazd sijaitsee maan keskiosassa, joten raportteja tuli sekä salmen läheltä Etelä-Iranista että sisämaasta. Mahdollisista henkilövahingoista ei kerrottu.

Iranin vallankumouskaarti väitti myöhään perjantaina, että kaksi öljytankkeria oli osunut miinoihin Hormuzinsalmen miinoitetulla laivaväylän osuudella ja räjähtänyt. Centcom kiisti myöhemmin väitteen ja kutsui sitä vääräksi. Vallankumouskaarti ei julkistanut asiasta tarkempia tietoja, joten osapuolten kuvaukset tapahtuneesta jäivät keskenään ristiriitaisiksi.

Perjantaina ei ollut selvää, liittyivätkö kaikki Iranissa raportoidut räjähdykset samaan Yhdysvaltain iskukierrokseen. Raportteja tuli kuitenkin useilta alueilta. Hormuzinsalmen tapahtumat jäivät kiistanalaisiksi, koska Yhdysvallat ja Iranin vallankumouskaarti esittivät tankkereista vastakkaiset väitteet.
summary_bullets: Centcomin mukaan Yhdysvallat aloitti uuden iskukierroksen Iraniin seitsemäntenä peräkkäisenä yönä.
Iranilaismediat raportoivat räjähdyksistä muun muassa Yazdissa, Qeshmillä ja Bandar Abbasissa.
Iranin vallankumouskaarti ja Centcom esittivät vastakkaiset väitteet kahden öljytankkerin räjähdyksistä Hormuzinsalmessa.
payload.journalist_note: Öljytankkereita koskeva väite on käsitelty kiistanalaisena, koska Centcom kiisti Iranin vallankumouskaartin kertomuksen eikä tapahtumasta annettu tarkempia tietoja.

article.source_text:
The US command says it is conducting more strikes to degrade Iran's armed forces, as Iran reports explosions near the Strait of Hormuz.

Central Command says attacks were designed to ‘continue degrading Iranian military capabilities’ The US military said it had launched a seventh consecutive night of strikes on Iran on Friday night as fighting escalated over the strait of Hormuz. US Central Command, in a post on X, said the strikes, which began at 7pm GMT, were designed to “continue degrading Iranian military capabilities”. Iranian media reported explosions heard or strikes carried out in the cities of Sirik, Ahvaz and Yazd. And late on Friday night Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said two oil tankers had hit mines in Hormuz and exploded. There were no further details.

Images shared on Friday showed a damaged bridge in Iran's southern Hormozgan province The US military says it is carrying out the seventh night of strikes on Iran since US President Donald Trump declared the temporary ceasefire agreement was "over". "The strikes are designed to continue degrading Iranian military capabilities at the Commander in Chief's direction," the US military Central Command (Centcom) said in a statement. Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said two oil tankers had exploded in the Strait of Hormuz while passing through a mined part of the shipping channel - a claim later dismissed as false by Centcom. Iranian media reported that explosions were heard in the central city of Yazd and at Qeshm island and the port of Bandar Abbas next to the strait.

The United States attacked bridges and other key infrastructure in southern Iran overnight into Friday, capping nearly a week of strikes aimed at intensifying pressure on Tehran to give up control of the Strait of Hormuz. A new round of attacks was announced Friday afternoon by U.S. Central Command. “CENTCOM launched a round of strikes against Iran at 3 p.m. ET today for the seventh consecutive night. The strikes are designed to continue degrading Iranian military capabilities at the Commander in Chief’s direction,” CENTCOM said in a post on X.
